categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the robotics industry chain, including core robot components (motion controllers, servo motors, servo drives), robot bodies (six-axis industrial robots, mobile robots, special robots), and robot system solutions. It serves industries such as automotive (including new energy vehicles), semiconductors, lithium batteries, electronics, photovoltaics, aerospace, and healthcare. Key business segments include industrial robots, logistics and warehousing automation equipment, automated assembly and inspection production lines, traffic automation systems, and semiconductor equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes autonomous innovation with over 800 national technology projects and numerous industry standards. Core technologies include industrial robot control, servo system design, robot software and programming, kinematic planning, 3D vision, and force sensing. Production methods involve market-oriented, make-to-order manufacturing with integrated system design, assembly, and testing. The company also develops AI-enabled platforms, intelligent programming, and advanced logistics systems, integrating AI, digital twins, and multi-sensor fusion for enhanced robot intelligence and performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are large enterprises in automotive (including new energy vehicles), semiconductors, lithium battery, electronics, photovoltaics, aerospace, and healthcare sectors. Notable clients include General Motors, FAW, SAIC, Tesla, BYD, CATL, North Huachuang, Micron Semiconductor, and others. The company serves both domestic and international markets, providing customized robot solutions and integrated automation systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant revenue from Northeast, North China, East China, South China, and Central China regions. It has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and offices in Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, India, Germany, Japan, Mexico, and the United States. The company actively pursues overseas markets in Europe, Southeast Asia, North America, and Asia-Pacific, adapting products and services to local market needs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the robotics supply chain. It manufactures core components, assembles robot bodies, and provides integrated system solutions and automation services. It also engages in strategic investments and collaborations to enhance upstream capabilities, especially in semiconductor equipment manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing technological innovation, profitability, market share, and operational efficiency. The company focuses on the '3+3+N' strategy: three core product lines (industrial, mobile, special robots), three application technologies (welding, assembly, logistics automation), and multiple strategic industry verticals. R&D emphasizes AI large models, intelligent vision perception, digital twins, structural bionics, and embodied intelligence. Key projects target automotive flexible welding lines, high-performance industrial robots, intelligent healthcare robots, precision robotic operations, and semiconductor vacuum mechanical arms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of industrial robots, automation equipment, and integrated system solutions. The company uses direct sales and public bidding to secure contracts, with some recurring orders from stable customers. It also earns income from strategic investments, licensing, and service contracts related to intelligent manufacturing solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic robotics manufacturer with a broad product portfolio and strong market presence. It competes with both domestic and foreign brands, particularly in automotive and semiconductor sectors. It holds a dominant position in China's industrial robot market, benefiting from national policies promoting domestic substitution and technological self-reliance. The company is recognized as a national engineering research center and a high-tech enterprise, with multiple industry leadership roles and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record revenue of approximately RMB 4.14 billion, a 4.33% increase year-over-year, despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 193.7 million due to decreased investment income and asset impairments. The company maintains total assets near RMB 12 billion and equity of about RMB 4.43 billion. It invested over RMB 300 million in R&D, representing about 7.28% of revenue. The company is expanding globally and growing its semiconductor equipment business rapidly, nearly doubling revenue in that segment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes autonomous innovation, comprehensive product lines, and high-quality integrated solutions tailored to diverse industries. It offers advanced robotics with high precision, flexibility, and stability, supported by proprietary control systems and AI technologies. Its ability to provide full digital factory solutions and deep industry expertise differentiates it from competitors. The company’s strong customer base, including global leaders, and its commitment to standards and quality management further enhance its competitive advantage.
